title: Algebraic automorphisms over a complete normed base are isometries
statement: Let F be a complete normed field and Ω a normed field with a NormedAlgebra F Ω structure, algebraic over F. Suppose q ∈ F satisfies 0 < ‖q‖ < 1. Then every F-algebra automorphism σ of Ω is an isometry for the given metric on Ω.
lean_statement: ∀ (F Ω : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F] [NormedField Ω] [NormedAlgebra F Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F Ω], ∀ q : F, 0 < ‖q‖ → ‖q‖ < 1 → ∀ σ : Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω, Isometry (fun x : Ω => σ x)
